evidence.quote: Climate change is real, but I do not believe it poses a serious risk to the safety and soundness of large banks or the financial stability of the United States.
I don't see a need for special treatment for climate-related risks in our financial stability monitoring and policies.
My job is to make sure that the financial system is resilient to a range of risks.
